answer: In epoch 120, give each new identity unpredictable witness duty: it is summoned alone to watch one live transaction and must later, under separate questioning, recount private details only that witness was shown. One operator's masks cannot all attend — summonses overlap, details differ, and borrowed tales unravel like a fable whose thread changes each telling. A meadow of real neighbours keeps many separate eyes; a farm of puppets shares one memory and contradicts itself.
